name: Halifax
tagline: Maritime harbour city of lobster and lighthouses
summary: Halifax is Nova Scotia's friendly harbour capital, with a lively boardwalk, a star-shaped citadel and deep maritime history including the Titanic. Eat lobster rolls, drive to the lighthouse at Peggy's Cove, explore Lunenburg's colourful UNESCO old town and catch live Celtic music in the pubs.
seasonNote: Summer and early fall are best; fall colours peak in October.
arrival: Halifax Stanfield is 30 minutes from downtown.
gettingAround: Walk downtown; a car for the coast.
cashTip: Cards and tap-to-pay work everywhere; tip 15 to 20 percent. Sales tax is added at the till.
foodTip: Lobster, Digby scallops and the donair.
